lead: S. Shankar is a widely followed Indian film director, born on 17 August 1963 in Kudanthaiyan.
As of 2026, he is 63 years old, and his birth date places him under the Leo sign.
He has 29 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Awards South and CNN-News18 Indian of the Year.
This profile collects the S. facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
